issue.title: Admin Center agent-CLI/plugins PNG snapshots capture the component list at a nondeterministic scroll offset
issue.description:
Three Admin Center (Updates/Plugins pane) PNG snapshots capture the left component list at a
nondeterministic scroll offset, so they drift by exactly one list row between runs on an
unchanged tree. Found by the sase-17x.13 land agent at master ea130c678 (2026-09-25); not
caused by the Command Line epic (no Command Line code renders in these tests).

Nodes:
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_agent_cli_install.py::test_config_center_updates_mark_all_clis_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_agent_cli_install.py::test_config_center_agent_cli_install_detail_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_plugins.py::test_config_center_plugins_community_detail_png_snapshot

Observations (same tree, ea130c678, no local diff):
1. Full `just test-visual` (all ACE + pager visual tests, 3 unrelated deterministic failures
   deselected; host load ~9): all three reported `updated`. The candidate list starts one row
   lower than the golden: the golden's first row is `sase-core v1.4.2` and its last visible
   row is `Antigravity CLI`; the capture's first row is `Plugins · Built-in` and its last
   visible row is `Muse Code latest v1.3.0-R3401.1 [script]`. Everything else, including the
   detail panel, is identical.
2. Targeted rerun `just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_agent_cli_install.py tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_plugins.py`
   (27 tests): only `config_center_updates_mark_all_clis_120x40` drifted; the other two
   matched their goldens.

So the list's scroll-to-highlight settle is timing dependent. The tests highlight a row
(`_highlight_row(pane, "cli:qwen")`) and force a detail render, but they do not wait for the
list's scroll offset to settle before `assert_page_png`. The likely fix is a wait on the list's
`scroll_offset` / highlighted-row visibility, or pinning the scroll explicitly, followed by a
deliberate regeneration if the settled offset differs from the goldens.

task_type_fields.evidence: 3 of 3 nodes drifted by one list row in a full just test-visual run at ea130c678; 1 of 3 drifted in an immediate targeted rerun on the same tree (27 passed, updated=1). Parallel xdist runs only; serial repro not attempted.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent on master 7cb835953: a full just test-visual (run 9449fcad3a9144099623213debd5bf8c, sase_41 workspace) drifted config_center_updates_mark_all_clis_120x40 (list scrolled one row: sase-core row visible at top) plus four more Admin Center agent-CLI list goldens in the same region: config_center_agent_clis_history_120x40, config_center_agent_clis_history_all_120x40, config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40, config_center_plugins_install_preview_120x40. In those four the Claude Code row's trailing up-arrow wraps onto its own line in the capture but not in the golden, which fits the same overflow/scroll-offset nondeterminism (the list's usable width changes with its scroll state). Unverified: whether those four share the root cause or are a separate width change.

payload.entry: Supplement from the sase-17x.13.10 land agent: a third full just test-visual on the same evening (run ac3da3d511a2424f9b63693d0155ea71) also drifted config_center_plugins_uninstall_preview_120x40 in the same Admin Center component-list region, while update_preview and plugins_install_preview did not drift that time. So the affected set varies run to run, which points to nondeterminism rather than stale content.
